name: mechon-panel
description: Mechon panel: the web UI and API for a self-hosted Discord bot host. Bots themselves need a Docker node.

MECHON_SECRET_KEY.description: Encrypts bot secrets at rest. 32 random bytes, base64. Generate with `mechon keygen`, or `openssl rand -base64 32`. Keep a copy: losing it makes stored bot secrets unreadable.

MECHON_PUBLIC_URL.description: Public https URL of this app. Heroku suffixes the default domain (e.g. https://my-panel-f47059b55334.herokuapp.com), so copy it from the app info. Leave blank to derive it from the Heroku app domain, which is always correct.

MECHON_TRUST_PROXY.description: Keep true: the Heroku router forwards the real client IP.
